meta.name: Hai Junoon
meta.description:
Talent vs Ambition. Music vs Dance. At Anderson College, rivalries explode in a cut-throat battle for the GOATs Trophy. Who will rise? Who will break?

Complete series. On your server: S1 20/20

videos.title: Lekar Hum Deewana Dil
videos.overview: Bikram is elated to meet award-winning musician Gagan at the SuperSonics' show. But Sebi and his team plot to steal the spotlight.

videos.title: Rahen Na Rahen Hum
videos.overview: Sebi pushes the dean to approve an official dance crew for Anderson's College. Meanwhile, an unexpected tragedy shakes the SuperSonics, leaving Gagan at a crossroads.

videos.title: Yahan Ke Hum Sikandar
videos.overview: Both teams kick off intense auditions - while the SuperSonics aim to cement their legacy, the dancers seek raw passion. Who will survive the cutthroat selection?

videos.title: Jab Chhaye Mera Jadoo
videos.overview: Pearl avoids conflict, but Sebi unknowingly pulls her back with an unexpected proposal. Meanwhile, Bikram devises a bold move to prove his worth to Gagan.

videos.title: Hai Apna Dil Toh Awara
videos.overview: Bikram's fresher's party takes an unexpected turn, spiralling into chaos. Meanwhile, Sebi and Shona's mischief unravels when they cross paths with a familiar face.

videos.title: Aaya Mausam Dosti ka
videos.overview: Gagan pushes the SuperSonics hard for the Christmas Gala, but tensions rise. As Sebi struggles to unite his team, Pearl and Charu spice things up with an interesting bet.

videos.title: Na Tum Jaano Na Hum
videos.overview: The SuperSonics have it all, but the Misfits struggle for even the basics. Sebi and Shona clash over Rohit's behaviour while Munmun gears up for her most intense debate yet.

videos.title: Arre Deewanon Mujhe Pehchano
videos.overview: With Sebi out, the Misfits' Christmas Gala performance hangs by a thread. A heated clash forces Adah out, leaving the SuperSonics without a lead singer.

videos.title: Hum Naache Bin Ghunghroo Ke
videos.overview: Costume chaos, missteps, and heartbreaks - envy and rivalry run wild at the Christmas Gala, turning the night into a whirlwind of drama, shocks and shattered expectations.

videos.title: Kal Kya Ho Kisne Jaana
videos.overview: Charu feels shattered by Gagan's choice. Swati drops a bombshell about Munmun, shaking everything up. Meanwhile, Shona decides it is time for a much-needed girls' night out.

videos.title: Jeena Yahan Marna Yahan
videos.overview: A shocking loss shakes Anderson's, unearthing a dark secret. The Misfits take a stand against Rohit. Charu steps beyond the SuperSonics, and Kush stumbles upon a new purpose.

videos.title: Hungama Ho Gaya
videos.overview: Charu's team faces off against Gagan's for the final GOATs selection. While Kush seeks Ashutosh's help for a mental health initiative, Sebi lands in hot water with the dean.

videos.title: Dhindhora Baje Re
videos.overview: Feeling miles behind Ashutosh, Kush plans something bold. Charu shatters Adah with a painful truth. Pearl takes on the dean, and Gagan faces an unexpected threat.

videos.title: Aawaz Do Humko
videos.overview: It's Kush versus Ashutosh in Anderson's College's high-stakes election. Gagan's life takes a sharp turn, and Pearl heads to Samasthiti in search of change.

videos.title: Duniya Se Nahi Darega
videos.overview: The Pride Fest challenges the existence of the SuperSonics and the Misfits. As they battle internal chaos, an external threat looms, putting Anderson's credibility on the line.

videos.title: Zindagi Ke Safar Mein
videos.overview: Gagan pushes the SuperSonics to their limits in the ultimate test. While Pearl faces a life-changing realisation, Sebi grapples with a make-or-break opportunity.

videos.title: Kya Se Kya Hogaya
videos.overview: Bikram is on a mission to pull Swati back from the edge. The SuperSonics crumble, pushing Gagan to his breaking point. Meanwhile, Pearl finds a hidden gem for the Misfits.

videos.title: Parde Mein Rehne Do
videos.overview: A devastating secret shatters the SuperSonics, leaving them without a mentor. The Misfits scramble for a new lead dancer. With GOATs a month away, both teams are falling apart!

videos.title: Jeet Jayenge Hum
videos.overview: The Misfits take on the SuperSonics in their music room. Both teams push through a gruelling training, gearing up for the ultimate showdown.

videos.title: Kahan Shuru Kahan Khatam
videos.overview: GOATs is packed with surprises as fierce competitors rise from across the country. Plans crumble and chaos reigns, but who will claim the ultimate trophy?
